The '''Bansidhe ion drive''' was a type of [[Ion engine/Legends|ion drive]] manufactured by [[Kuat Drive Yards/Legends|Kuat Drive Yards]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. One of these [[Engine/Legends|engines]] was mounted on each [[KV swoop]].<ref name="ETU" />
